# Customer Orders Bootstrap Clause

Prepares hosted customer Orders from exact quote and customer requirements. `quotes` defaults to `/quotes`, fulfilment configuration to `/clauses/fulfilment/parameters`, party mapping includes seller and partner, and sources defaults empty. The destination collection and template are configured. Parameters select external provision, independent bootstrap, partner as supplier and customer as the declared supplied party.

The clause exposes preparation, provision, cancellation and readiness refresh, with `startOrder` using its order-specific preparation checks. Allowed prepared fields are `orderDescription`, `amountMinor`, `customerAccountId`, `quote`, `quoteBlueId`, `orderSnapshot` and `orderRequest`. Domain checks and exact native function references preserve the quoted requirement; a type name or matching business amount alone is not sufficient.

Preparation freezes a requirement before creation or provision. Provision requires the expected supplier, request correlation, requirement reference and initialized document origin. Normalized source, effective policy, every party role and identity, allowed value slots and approval requirements must match. An extra undeclared party is rejected even when the child acquired it through its own admission; a stored witness cannot authorize an expanded roster. An unrelated old field alone is not a rejection rule.

Selection is distinct from usability. General admission can seek authorized approval, the incoming participant's consent and access before linking. A selected child becomes usable only when its Activation is active and its source and reader requirements are ready. Identity substitution is rejected; matching retries do not create a second obligation.

Configuration references: `bindings.collection` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.fulfilment` defaults to `/clauses/fulfilment/parameters`; `bindings.parties` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.quotes` defaults to `/quotes`; `bindings.sources` is configured by the caller/type context; `bindings.template` is configured by the caller/type context; `parameters.allowedFields` declares `["orderDescription","amountMinor","customerAccountId","quote","quoteBlueId","orderSnapshot","orderRequest"]`; `parameters.obtain` declares `"provide"`; `parameters.prepareFor` declares `"bootstrap"`; `parameters.suppliedBy` declares `"partner"`; `parameters.suppliedParties` declares `["customer"]`.
